design_brief: Compact functional break-area prop; icon labels distinguish bins without tiny text. V2 is a perspective-correct three-stream recycling sorter with an explicit footprint-derived top plane and camera-front elevation.
gameplay_scope: Art and future layout proposal only; no new hiring, role behavior, tool authority, transaction or interaction is implemented.

current_availability.direction_art_review: N/E/S/W recycling-sorter-v2 passive art passes the 2026-09-06 agent-native review. Every view has the full physical footprint translated upward as a top plane, a separate elevation to contact, fixed light, three top-plane apertures with distinct front/rear/end profiles, exact alpha/layers/anchors, and actual GameMain wall/route/depth evidence. Approval is passive-library only: no production/runtime binding, default placement, interaction, service, hire, role pose or backend is claimed.

previous_catalogue_availability.direction_art_review: No finished art or runtime family is claimed for this proposal; unrelated concept/source art may exist.

native_geometry.anchor_rule: One unchanged canvas coordinate represents local floor pivot [0,0] in every direction and every layer. Transparent padding is not sprite scaling.

dimension_review.revision: V1 treated the body as a flat elevation. V2 retains the original canvas, pivot and masks, but interprets the planned rise as the solid's vertical elevation and separately records the 32px or 64px projected footprint depth. The full top plane is the physical floor rectangle translated upward by one consistent family elevation.

native_geometry.top_plane_contract: For each facing, top_plane_px is exactly floor_plane_px translated by [0,-vertical_elevation_px], with identical width/depth; camera_front_elevation_px starts at the top plane near edge and ends at floor contact.
